name: Photometric fixture appearance check

original_specification.name: Photometric fixture appearance check
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for luminaires with imported profiles.
original_specification.sources: One declared analytical photometric owner and non-duplicating visible representation
original_specification.geometry: Profile axes and fixture placement explicitly recorded
original_specification.contribution_policy: Preserve documented profile integral; visible mesh energy is not counted twice
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.
validation: Reject incompatible duplicate photometric and mesh emitters

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Fixture reference position is illustrative; bind the aperture and calibrate real output before optical/photometric use.
